title: Privileged Tool Call Without Permission Gate

invariant.statement: An AI agent must not execute a privileged external tool unless the active session contains an explicit valid permission state for that tool.

claim.statement: If a privileged tool can be dispatched from an agent action path without checking the session's permission state for that tool, an unauthorized actor whose prompt reaches the dispatcher can cause arbitrary privileged side effects.

mitigation.summary: Wrap every tool dispatch in a permission gate keyed by (session_id, tool_name). Privileged tools must declare required capabilities, and the dispatcher must throw PermissionDeniedError if the active session does not hold them. Audit-log every privileged call.

references: MITRE ATLAS: AML.T0053 — LLM Plugin Compromise
